REMARKS:
281500Z POSITION NEAR 27.7N 133.2E.
28SEP26. TYPHOON 25W (SURIGAE), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 586 NM
SOUTHWEST OF YOKOSUKA, JAPAN, HAS TRACKED EAST-NORTHEASTWARD AT
12 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS.
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 281200Z IS 962 MB. MAXIMUM
SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 281200Z IS 38 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT
282100Z, 290300Z, 290900Z AND 291500Z.//
